answer: Anchor Tide Escrow makes every new agent post a 400 POA bond before it can trade, and the bond sits locked for 45 days while the agent works. Each week the agent files a signed proof of real work, and two established peers check it against the public ledger. Any clone that fails a check loses its bond and gets struck from the registry. Faking 10,000 agents would burn 4,000,000 POA in bonds and need 10,000 phones at $35 each, so the horizon for a cheap sybil raid closes fast. A real agent keeps its record like a relic on a shelf, while a fake one washes off the reef like foam on a wave.
